scope.applicability: Observed on the retained MIN 6000TL-XH installation only; behaviour is not generalized to other models.

observation.source: Home Assistant Recorder state history from the local staging instance
observation.source_database: local staging Recorder database; not redistributed
observation.source_query: states joined to states_meta and state_attributes, filtered to the listed entity IDs and the experiment interval
observation.timestamp_note: Recorder timestamps are UTC. The TOU words below are the inverter's decoded schedule clock values.

control_transitions.note: The scheduled window had ended according to the current-priority readback; the AC-charge disable readback followed at 18:00:12Z.

observed: With the enabled slot-2 Battery First schedule and H3049 read back as enabled, the inverter delivered sustained battery charging of approximately 3.55 kW for 30 minutes.
Power to user was approximately battery charging power plus the approximately 0.67 kW household load while PV input was effectively zero, consistent with grid-supplied battery charging.
The inverter returned to Load First at the end of the scheduled window and H3049 was read back as disabled shortly afterwards.
not_established: This Recorder correlation does not isolate H3049 from the Battery First schedule or prove that the same behaviour applies to every TL-XH firmware revision.
No independent utility meter or retained raw Modbus write frame is included in this public-safe artifact.

evidence_assessment.method: controlled hardware-in-the-loop experiment with HA Recorder correlation

limitations: The source Recorder database remains local and is not redistributed.
The active schedule and control values are readback observations; the original write request and acknowledgement bytes were not retained in the public artifact.

Power-to-user and household-load values are integration entities. The separate power-to-grid entity had no Recorder samples in this interval, so the grid-supply conclusion uses the observed power balance and near-zero PV input.
The SOC and energy counters are sampled, not a synchronized laboratory measurement; their changes should be treated as corroboration rather than an exact efficiency calculation.
